name: Hail of Thorns
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon
description: The triggering ranged hit bursts into thorns. The target and every creature within 5 feet make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.
